# Supported boards

120 mainline-supported Rockchip ARM64 boards, built from U-Boot v2026.04.

Each board has at least an SD / eMMC image; some also ship an SPI-flash image,
and the OP-TEE-capable SoCs ship an extra `-optee` variant. Filenames use the
U-Boot **defconfig** name:

- `u-boot-<defconfig>.bin` — write to SD card or eMMC (`dd … seek=64`).
- `u-boot-<defconfig>-spi.bin` — write to SPI flash (offset 0).
- `u-boot-<defconfig>-optee.bin` / `-optee-spi.bin` — same, with the OP-TEE secure world bundled.

The **FOSS** column marks boards whose entire boot chain is built from source (no
proprietary Rockchip blob): U-Boot's own TPL initialises DRAM and BL31 comes from
mainline Arm Trusted Firmware. Other boards embed Rockchip's prebuilt DDR and/or
BL31 blob from [rkbin](https://github.com/rockchip-linux/rkbin).

See [the README](../README.md) for download, flashing and verification steps.
